messages:
Jordan H: Heads-up: Acme Apps reporting multiple Visa card declines during checkout since 09:12 PST. They say CVV passed but Stripe returned 'card_declined' with AVS result 'N'. Order A-7393, customer ops@acme.com. Any quick checks?

Priya K: Can you paste the Stripe payment_intent / charge id and the request payload (billing address sent)?

Jordan H: pi_3KjXabcd12345 / ch_3KjXchg_9ef... last4 4242 bin 424242. Here's the billing request we send:
```json
{\"amount\":14900,\"currency\":\"usd\",\"payment_method_data\":{\"card\":{\"brand\":\"visa\",\"last4\":\"4242\"}},\"billing_details\":{\"name\":\"Sam Lee\",\"address\":{\"line1\":\"100 Market St\",\"line2\":\"Ste 400\",\"city\":\"San Francisco\",\"state\":\"CA\",\"postal_code\":\"94105\"}}}
```
Stripe response snippet:
```json
{\"id\":\"ch_3KjXchg_9ef...\",\"status\":\"failed\",\"failure_code\":\"card_declined\",\"outcome\":{\"type\":\"issuer_decline\",\"reason\":\"avs_failure\",\"seller_message\":\"The card has been declined by the issuer\"}}
```

Priya K: Looks like Stripe flagged avs_failure. Quick question: are we normalizing address_line2 to 'Ste' vs 'Suite'? Stripe AVS checks are strict — 'STE 400' vs 'Suite 400' can flip result. We pushed a frontend change last week that strips punctuation; could be related. Can you repro locally by sending variants for line2?

Jordan H: Repro steps I ran: curl against our billing service with line2 'Ste 400' => failed; with line2 'Suite 400' => succeeded. Short diff attached. Frontend currently sends 'Ste 400'.

Luca R: If you can repro, escalate to Stripe with the charge id + repro evidence. Stripe will sometimes adjust AVS scoring with the issuer if provided with clear repro. Also check 3DS: if we didn't attempt 3DS the issuer may decline for fraud reasons. Any three_d_secure flags?

Priya K: Logs show three_d_secure: not_requested for these payment intents. That may be expected for this merchant, but issuer is strict here. I'm creating an internal ticket to track.

billing-bot: Ticket created: BILL-1124 - "AVS false negative due to address normalization" assigned to Priya K. Stripe case CS-77421 opened referencing ch_3KjXchg_9ef...

Jordan H: Thanks — will patch checkout to send 'Suite 400' for now and notify Acme. I'll add a note to the merchant integration doc about canonicalizing address_line2. @product-payments FYI.

Priya K: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with Stripe and paste their reply here. If they ask, include the successful vs failed charge timestamps and the charge ids (I already attached them to CS-77421).
